requested_decision: Authorize this finite evidence-only stage after verified CAP delivery. Separate source admission required before any helper execution; no build/product/schema edits.

entry_gate.required: CAP PR21 exact public commit08371fea full identity resolved in actual method; both exactHEADCI success, Root and independentQA whole anonymous source equality+downloaded audits and actual process/resource closure before22:30UTC.
entry_gate.if_missed: Do not execute this stage; retain explicit unexecuted backlog.

timebox.rule: Stage starts after fresh fixed-five Council and completed CAP gate; stage delivery deadline is startUTC+60minutes, never later than sprintdeadline. No new native work after00:30:37UTC. Preserve final90-minute sprint deliveryreserve.

risk_appetite: Medium bounded evidence-only native observation; prospectively fixed input semantics, independent QA/TD reviews, original process/fullcapture and resource guards. No product/schema/build changes or installs.

immutable_runtime.operation: Authenticated XES toCSV with allow_metadata_loss=false; one active operation at a time.

fixture_oracle_plan.generator: One bounded deterministic source-only generator to be reviewed before native execution. Exact UTF8 bytes are emitted with LF, no BOM. No random values or environment-dependent timestamps.

structure.xml: Flat XES without log metadata, declarations/extensions/global/container/list, one trace concept:name=complexity-case, every event concept:name=A and time:timestamp=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000000001Z. No lifecycle field.
structure.ordering: Events remain in original order. Repeated identical event values intentionally emphasize count and per-event report expansion, not activity diversity or graph complexity.
structure.csv: Header case,activity,timestamp,lifecycle; each expected row complexity-case,A,2026-01-01T00:00:00.000000001Z, with parser/writer normalized newline explicitly recorded. Compare parsed core rows, not assume unverified CSV raw serialization.

fixture_oracle_plan.manual_oracles: Before measurement write independent expectations for exactly1trace and10000/90000events, case/activity/timestamp/lifecycle absent, no permitted losses. Successful output must have exact row count and core values/order, report input/target hash+byte declarations and statusconverted. Refused outcome must preserve actual reason and have no payload; do not assert target semantics that were never produced.
fixture_oracle_plan.preflight: Generated input each<=20MiB, eventcount<=100000; record generatorSHA,inputSHA,actualbytes, manualoracleSHA and binary/settingsSHA in signed method inventory before first measurement. If static generation violates agreed limits stop/replan before any observed outcome, no post-outcome tuning.

measurement_protocol.owner: Root owns all native execution. QA independently reads actual artifacts and manual oracles; TD audits claims and no-product-change boundaries.
measurement_protocol.cases: Exactly one fresh stock app process per input. Use same existing PostgreSQL instance/settings with bounded readiness check. One client and one conversion at a time; no overlapping work, no load generator. Do not merge process lifetimes.
measurement_protocol.baseline: Record app readiness and pre-request baseline sample. Later native lifetime peaks include startup and all activity within that case; sampled maxima and allocator residue labeled separately.
measurement_protocol.metrics: Actual server process creation identity, wall/admission/queue/conversion intervals only if actually observable, sampled working set/private bytes at approximately50ms with actual intervals retained, available Windows native lifetime peak working set/privatecommit counters. Server counters exclude PostgreSQL/client/Root.
measurement_protocol.outcomes: Keep all actual converted/report_byte_limit/otherrefusal/failure/timeout outcomes. Both10k and90k may reach report_byte_limit; never alter counts, inputsemantics, limits or runtime to manufacture converted output.
measurement_protocol.capture: Bounded full required stdout/stderr/process+HTTP/jobstate/measurement files with bytes/hashes/EOF and explicit captured/missing/unknown intervals. No credentials/sessionraw published. Input metadata and semantically public synthetic source can be published.
measurement_protocol.limits: At most2cases,120seconds per case,20minutes total native runtime including supporting bounded checks, same12GiBglobal/8GiBRoot/8GiBfree/512MiBheadroom. No compiler/install or oldrootmutation.

acceptance.criterion: Two actual input files and independentmanualoracles, generator+appidentity+settings pinned before measurement; staticvalidity/event/bytebounds demonstrated.
Both fixed cases actually observed once and every outcome retained; complete required processidentity/captures. Failedrefusals remain failures/refusals; no retuned repeat.

IndependentQA manually derived count/corevalues/order and report byte/hash inventory for every converted outcome; for refused outcome verify explicit reason and no falsepayload/result plus durable source identity.

Memory/time table labels true observation scope and exactlyone observation per case; no SLO/speedup/hardRAM/worstcase/enterpriseclaim. Existing18MiB/two-event case is historical contextual comparison with different method, not matched experimental control.

No product/schema/runtime bytechange; independentQA+TD accept exact finite results; finalfrozenCouncil and public exactHEADbothCI/wholeanonymousRootQAreadback with downloaded audits and actualprocess/resourceclosure complete inside60minutes.

publication_plan: Source/evidence-only separate branch/PR on accepted CAP head; source changes confined to exact experiment generator/oracles/audit/docs/evidence and Councilrecords. No runtime release tag or merge. Reuse accepted bounded capture/publicprojection workflow; preserve exact raw numeric lexemes, failures and metadata scopes.
